description: This PHP script manages the display and handling of duplicate contacts in the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves duplicate contact data based on session and POST variables, prepares and renders an HTML template with contact details, and handles form submissions and various request parameters related to contact duplication workflows.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: A template rendering class used to generate HTML content based on the provided template file and assigned variables.

classes.name: SugarEmailAddress
classes.description: A class that handles email address widgets and their display logic.

classes.name: ContactFormBase
classes.description: A class responsible for managing contact form interactions, including building table forms for displaying contact data.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Builds an HTML table form for displaying a list of contact records.

methods.name: getEmailAddressWidgetDuplicatesView
methods.description: Generates email address widget HTML for displaying email addresses in the duplicates view.
